description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Feed, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_AbstractDevice. It provides functionality for identifying and classifying user agents that are feed readers, including signature matching and feature definition methods.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Feed
classes.description: Represents a feed type user agent and provides methods to match user agent strings against known feed signatures and define features related to feed user agents.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if a given user agent string matches known feed signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of user agent, which is 'feed' for this class.

methods.name: _defineFeatures
methods.description: Defines specific features that feed user agents typically do or do not support, like iframes, frames, and javascript.
